    The height argument #

    For admissible special biserial path data, a combination of nonzero paths from x with a nonzero coefficient on a path that is not a longest path can be pushed, by multiplying with a path of positive length, to a nonzero combination of longest paths (exists_kill). This gives the simple socle of A e_x at a binomial vertex (socle) and the vanishing of coefficients modulo the socle (coeff_eq_zero).
